class.name: UltralightSingleton
class.brief_description: Control the shared Ultralight renderer and remote inspector.
class.description:
The engine-registered singleton shared by all Ultralight views. Obtain it with [code]Engine.get_singleton("UltralightSingleton")[/code] in GDScript, or [code]Engine.Singleton.GetSingleton("UltralightSingleton")[/code] in C#.
Logic updates are connected to the SceneTree process frame, and rendering to RenderingServer frame_pre_draw. Most applications need no manual update calls.

method.name: update_logic
method.description: Update timers and dispatch callbacks. This runs automatically each SceneTree process frame. If automatic processing is disabled with [method set_process], call this regularly from the application loop.

method.name: update_frame
method.description: Internal lifecycle callback. Render active views to CPU surfaces or GPU render targets. It is connected automatically to RenderingServer frame_pre_draw; applications should not invoke it manually.

method.name: set_process
method.description: Enable or disable automatic logic updates. This does not disconnect automatic rendering. When disabled, the application must call [method update_logic] to advance timers and callbacks.

method.name: start_remote_inspector_server
method.description: Start the remote Inspector server on address and port; return whether it starts successfully. Call on the Godot main thread and connect with the matching mini-browser package.
